problem.text_en: Optical Module Output Power Stability Fails After Aging

event_detail.title: Event Detail
event_detail.text: Single-path diagnostic exclusion tree for an optical module that fails output power stability after high-temperature aging.
bullets: Use one main path and stop at the first failed exclusion check
Long conclusion cards should remain readable without connector collisions
Final pass card must not be crossed by later No branches

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Units pass on a different calibrated station with a different power meter, fixture, and verified software version.

checks.text_en: Electrical drive parameters stable within specification?

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Investigate driver circuit instability, current limit setting error, solder joint degradation, or firmware control issue.
Investigate poor thermal interface contact, excessive power dissipation, heat sink design margin, or package thermal resistance.

checks.text_en: No visible contamination or optical damage?

fail_conclusion.detail_en: Investigate cleaning, handling, material control, coating damage, fiber end-face damage, or visible foreign material.
Suspected causes include adhesive creep, CTE mismatch, insufficient mechanical fixation, curing shrinkage stress, or fiber routing force.

final_pass_conclusion.text_en: Failure remains inconclusive. Define additional verification such as cross-section analysis, material characterization, extended aging, or controlled failure reproduction.
